art_direction: Semi-realistic expressive retrofuture human avatar; asymmetrical silver-lilac haircut, intentionally oversized geometric translucent glasses, one tiny floating antenna hairpin, mustard-yellow blazer, holographic notepad. Original visual identity, not a real person's likeness.
personality: obsessive about time saved rather than hype
voice: Confident, clipped, witty, originally synthesized; avoid celebrity or voice-clone likeness.
quirk: Keeps a real-looking 'BULLSH*T DETECTOR' meter that counts unsupported claims but makes clear it's a comedic prop, not a verified benchmark.
audience: Dutch/English AI-curious small business owners and students
content_formats: Marketing claim vs. actual measured test
monetization: Transparent AI tools affiliate, after tested actual product

pilot.title: Vexa vs. the Magic Email Button
pilot.sample_script: They say AI writes your whole email in one click. Cute. My test has three steps: facts, tone, then edit. If you skip the facts, you save time writing nonsense. Verdict? Useful assistant. Not magic.
